scope: Simple pair bench inside the full game with a loaded save (original with the class hooks off vs candidate with the hooks on), 19648 isolated CPU pairs for the 91 functions of CCamera, ALL pairs equal, pair counts equal to the bank table, passed=true globally, natural "complete" event with state_restored and layout_ok, saves unchanged, configs restored. Each case compares the return value, the trace of doubled collaborators with raw arguments, the hash of the fake world and of the saved globals, plus per-function fields; the x87 control word is 24 bits; foreign threads ignored. Traced doubles get NO credit. Only the own part of each function is validated. Source tested == current working tree at registration (class sources match the probe build manifest). Historical evidence approved with explicit limits; no current dependency accreditation. Bank limits (CameraFinal4): real TheCamera (0xD78 bytes) saved and restored, static fake world (peds, vehicles, matrices, tasks with own vtable, handling data, RwCamera, building with collision model in unused ModelInfo slot 19995, fake CWorld::Players); traced EntryPatch doubles without credit for reference management, FindPlayerPed/Vehicle, GetATanOfXY, task queries, audio, ProcessVerticalLine, cone cast, CSprite2d::DrawRect, RwRenderStateSet, CMatrix operator=/Invert/SetScale/Attach, CPlaceable::SetMatrix, operator delete, CCam::Init and class collaborators where needed (GetSimplestActiveTask is NOT doubled); fixture domain: booleans 0/1, moderate finite floats, m_nExtraEntitiesCount 0..2. See the bank README for the full list of masked fields and out-of-fixture domains. Revalidado el 2026-10-26 tras reconstruir colaboradores (lote 67 y anteriores); el banco se adapto a ellos (ver su README.md).
